meta.title: Mid-Event Lot Splitting: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Buyer user and the Buyer user on the specified Growth tenant.
Locate and attempt Mid-Event Lot Splitting to split RFQ lines into lots during an active event.
Verify that the non-Buyer action is refused or absent and that the Buyer can perform it.
Record the tenant's actual RBAC configuration if additional roles are intentionally granted access.
